title: Baked Salmon with Couscous and Broccolini
desc: Plain salmon fillets baked until browned, on fluffy couscous with broccolini and a Greek yoghurt sauce. Easy weeknight omega 3.

portions.J: 200 g raw salmon (a large fillet, about 150 g cooked), about 1 cup cooked couscous, 100 g broccolini
portions.P: 130 g raw salmon (a regular fillet, about 100 g cooked), about 2/3 cup cooked couscous, 90 g broccolini

steps.title: Salmon in
steps.text: Oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Pat the salmon dry and put it skin side down on a lined tray, nothing on it. Bake until browned on top and it just flakes in the middle.

steps.title: Couscous
steps.text: While it bakes, boil the kettle. Put the couscous in a bowl with a pinch of salt, pour over the same volume of boiling water (about 3/4 cup for both of you), cover with a plate and leave 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.

steps.title: Broccolini
steps.text: Steam or microwave the broccolini with a splash of water for 3 to 4 minutes, until bright green and just tender.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Couscous on the plate, broccolini alongside, salmon on top and the sauce over or beside it.

notes: Salmon is higher in fat than the other dinners, but it's mostly omega 3. Thicker fillets may need 2 to 3 more minutes. Wholemeal couscous cooks the same way and roughly doubles the fibre.
